Privacy

Last updated 3 September 2026

The short version: our extensions collect nothing about you, and this website sets no cookies, loads no webfonts and runs no analytics.

This website

quiteapps.co.uk is a set of static files. There is no tracking script, no advertising pixel and no cookie banner, because there are no cookies to consent to. Type is set in your device's own system font, so no font requests leave your browser either. Our host keeps standard server access logs, which include IP addresses, for security and troubleshooting; we do not analyse them or share them.

The extensions

Every permission each extension asks for is listed with its reason on that extension's own page. Three of them run on a single site each and cannot see any other tab you have open; the fourth, Quite for Cookies, installs with no access to any site at all and asks for one domain at a time, when you press the button. None of them contain analytics, remote code, or a server of ours for your data to sit on. Three of them keep your settings in Chrome's own extension-settings sync, so with Chrome sync switched on those settings travel with your Chrome profile, the same as any extension's. That is Google's transport and not ours; nothing reaches us either way.

Quite for YouTube. Quite for YouTube runs only on youtube.com and has no permission to access any other site. No server, no analytics, no account, no tracking, and nothing is sent to us. It stores the checkboxes you have ticked and a running count of what it has skipped or hidden. Settings use Chrome's own extension-settings sync, so with Chrome sync switched on they travel with your Chrome profile, the same as any extension's settings. There is also a diagnostic log that records which videos you hopped between, which is off unless you switch it on with ?ytachistory=1, and which Chrome clears when you quit. See its permissions.

Quite for Facebook. Quite for Facebook runs only on facebook.com and has no permission to access any other site. No server, no analytics, no account, no tracking, and nothing is sent to us. It stores the checkboxes you have ticked and a running count of what it has hidden. Settings use Chrome's own extension-settings sync, so with Chrome sync switched on they travel with your Chrome profile, the same as any extension's settings. See its permissions.

Quite for Instagram. Quite for Instagram runs only on instagram.com and has no permission to access any other site. No server, no analytics, no account, no tracking, and nothing is sent to us. It stores the checkboxes you have ticked and a running count of what it has hidden. Settings use Chrome's own extension-settings sync, so with Chrome sync switched on they travel with your Chrome profile, the same as any extension's settings.

Quite for Cookies. Quite for Cookies installs with no access to any website. It sends nothing anywhere. No server, no analytics, no account, no tracking. The only things it stores are your per-site choices, the counters shown in the popup, and a short local log of what the automatic clear has done, all in your own browser. See its permissions.

Nothing is sold

The extensions are free and MIT licensed. There is no purchase, no licence key and no payment processor involved, so there is no payment data for anyone to hold.

You can check all of this

The full source of every released extension is public. If you would rather verify than trust, the code is at github.com/KingDogma23.

Email

If you write to us, we keep the message so we can reply and so we remember the conversation next time. We do not add you to a mailing list, because we do not have one.

Your rights

Under UK GDPR you may ask what personal data we hold about you and ask us to delete it. In practice this is almost always just an email thread. Write to hello@quiteapps.co.uk and we will deal with it within thirty days.
